title: Pioneer History of Milwaukee — Alanson Sweet biography
citation: James S. Buck, Pioneer History of Milwaukee, vol. 1, biographical notice of Alanson Sweet, stating he came from Owasco, New York in 1835 and had worked his stone-mason trade in early Chicago.
notes: Confirms migration from Chicago-era Illinois into Milwaukee during 1835, but without a precise departure date in this passage; July 1 presence therefore remains unresolved.
